name: a later human reply reopens the same thread episode

source.reason: Two human messages in one Slack thread became separate legacy episodes instead of one serialized conversation.
source.session_turn_invariant: A same-work reply retains the seed episode and any pinned session; reopening installs the next turn on that episode rather than creating a second episode.

content.text:
IDK if you deployed but it's still a redirect:
```❯ curl -I <https://blitzapp.gg/ads.txt>
HTTP/2 301
date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 00:09:50 GMT
content-type: text/html
content-length: 169```
also we don't have www. subdomain attached, do we need it?

decision.reason: This is a new instruction in the exact same Slack thread.

accepted_alternatives.reason: This is a direct follow-up to the ads.txt redirect discussion. Whether www is needed can be answered conversationally, while distinguishing general guidance from unverified domain configuration.
